title: Dark Ritual Gathering
description: A surreal black and white scene depicts a large multi-armed deity-like figure with a golden headdress and third eye, seated atop a mound covered in crawling insects. Below, a circle of hooded cultists kneel in worship, each holding or surrounded by glowing golden rings, set against a dark background with floating orbs and swirling smoke patterns above the central figure.
